statement.p: Find the gradient of the function f(x,y,z) = 2xe^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(4z\right).

static.solution: f_x = 2e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(4z\right), f_y = 2x\cdot 0.25e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(4z\right), and f_z = 2xe^{\frac{y}{4}}\cdot 4\cos\mathopen{}\left(4z\right). Thus \mbox{grad} f = 2e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(4z\right)\,\mathit{\vec i}+2x\cdot 0.25e^{\frac{y}{4}}\sin\mathopen{}\left(4z\right)\,\mathit{\vec j}+2xe^{\frac{y}{4}}\cdot 4\cos\mathopen{}\left(4z\right)\,\mathit{\vec k}.
